title: Joe Smith, Bobby Hackett and recognising Louis's sound
summary: Joe Smith's beautiful sound is echoed by Bobby Hackett, who also plays like Louis; Dickenson knew Louis's sound on records.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: There was another great trumpet player by the name of Joe Smith. He had a beautiful sound, very beautiful. Who reminds me of him more today than anyone, who certainly has got a beautiful sound like that, and then he plays like Louis, too (I mean, he plays all the intervals

like Louis), is Bobby Hackett. He's got this beautiful sound. That's how Joe Smith sounded. So it's like... So you can see why I'm very fond of Bobby Hackett! He's got two guys I like, yeah, all wrapped in him, you know.
Yeah, you and Bobby have been working together for quite a while...
So when you heard Louis play behind those singers, was his name on the record, like that, so you knew who that was...?
I think so, but I'm not sure. I just can't recall back in those days...
But you knew it was him.
I knew his sound, you know.
